name: headroom
description: Suggests a /clear with a toast when the context fill reaches a set point, then again each step after.

firstPoint.title: First reminder point
firstPoint.description: Context fill, in percent, at which the first /clear reminder shows.

step.title: Step between reminders
step.description: Points the fill must rise after a reminder before the next one shows.

toastSeconds.title: Toast seconds
toastSeconds.description: How long each reminder toast stays up, in seconds.
